definition{
  name: pinMatches,
  parameters: [pin : Pin],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((project pin expected) =? (project pin observed))
}

definition{
  name: conformant,
  parameters: [observation : Observation],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((pinMatches (project observation devcontainer)) && ((pinMatches (project observation bootstrap)) && ((pinMatches (project observation agents)) && ((pinMatches (project observation verification)) && ((pinMatches (project observation prismpmLock)) && (pinMatches (project observation templateContract)))))))
}

definition{
  name: Conformant,
  parameters: [observation : Observation],
  result: Prop,
  body: (((project (project observation devcontainer) expected) = (project (project observation devcontainer) observed)) /\ (((project (project observation bootstrap) expected) = (project (project observation bootstrap) observed)) /\ (((project (project observation agents) expected) = (project (project observation agents) observed)) /\ (((project (project observation verification) expected) = (project (project observation verification) observed)) /\ (((project (project observation prismpmLock) expected) = (project (project observation prismpmLock) observed)) /\ ((project (project observation templateContract) expected) = (project (project observation templateContract) observed)))))))
}

theorem{
  name: conformant_decides,
  parameters: [observation : Observation],
  statement: (((conformant observation) = true) <-> (Conformant observation)),
  proof: simplify{definitions: [Bool.and_eq_true, Conformant, Nat.beq_eq, conformant, pinMatches]},
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: digestFrom,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, remaining : Nat, accumulated : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match remaining
    | Nat.zero => accumulated
    | Nat.succ rest => (match (Foundation.Bytes::byteAt value offset)
      | Option.none => accumulated
      | Option.some byte => (digestFrom value (offset + 1) rest ((prim multiply accumulated 256 : Nat) + (prim to_nat byte : Nat))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: remaining
}

definition{
  name: pinAt,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat],
  result: Pin,
  body: (record Pin {expected := (digestFrom value offset 32 0), observed := (digestFrom value (offset + 32) 32 0)}),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
